pricing.option_redaction_pitch: A beautiful site with weak copy doesn't convert. We write words that actually sell — crafted for your audience and optimised for Google.
pricing.option_visuels_pitch: Generic stock photos stick out. We create unique visuals that make your brand stand out and build trust at first glance.

pricing.option_photo_note: * Available in Paris and Jerusalem. Other cities on request.
pricing.option_seo_pitch: An invisible website on Google is useless. We position you on the searches your clients are making — so they find you, not your competitors.

devis.options_subtitle_selected: Add the options that complete your pack.
devis.options_subtitle_empty: Choose a pack to unlock the options.
devis.recap_empty: Select a pack to see your total.
devis.cond_text1: Your pack price includes a set number of pages. Any extra page beyond that limit is billed at €150 (₪510) per page, design and integration included.
devis.cond_text2: Two rounds of revisions are included with every pack, covering copy, visuals and layout adjustments. Any extra round is billed at €90 (₪310) per cycle.
devis.cond_text3: The timelines shown start once we receive all content (copy, images, access) and after the brief is validated. Any delay in providing these elements shifts delivery accordingly.
devis.cond_text4: A 40% deposit is required upon quote approval to start the project. The remaining 60% is due on delivery, before final files are handed over and the site goes live.
devis.cond_text5: Hosting, domain registration and copywriting are not included in our packs, unless you've selected the matching option. We're happy to help you set these up if needed.
devis.cond_info: By clicking "I've read and I agree", you confirm you've read these terms. They'll be restated in the detailed quote we send you.
